data.one_liner: A Flutter widget that stacks avatars or any widgets with configurable alignment, coverage and animation.
data.what_it_does: Provides AnimatedAvatarStack, AvatarStack and WidgetStack to display a collection of images or custom widgets in an overlapping stack. Supports limiting item count, alignment, coverage percentages, info badge, and animation.
use_when: You need to show many user avatars in a compact space
You want a customizable overlapping stack of arbitrary widgets
You require built‑in animation for the stack
avoid_when: You need complex grid or list layouts
You require advanced state‑management or networking features
strengths: Highly configurable (alignment, coverage, limit, info widget)
Supports any widget, not just images
Built‑in animation and easy to use
weaknesses: Only provides stacking UI, no data handling
Limited to visual layout, no built‑in responsiveness beyond provided settings
